name: task-plan
description: Compact inline plans with a matching static Codex goal for long-running tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-managed inline plans for long tasks.
interface.longDescription: Creates compact revisable task plans, links subagent subplans to parent-step progress, tracks parallel work, and re-anchors the card only after enough visual output and a real progress change.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create and maintain an inline task plan for this work.
